failure_mode: Internal short leads to thermal runaway of one cell
effect: Vent gas and heat; fire risk to rider
cause: Manufacturing defect, dendrites, crush, fast-charge plating
prevention_today: Per-cell Al wire-bond fuse (0.19 ms model); 0.4 mm wire not final; BMS monitoring
detection_today: Cell voltage and temperature sensing (1 NTC per few cells)
recommended_action: Single-cell trigger test on a lane module; set wire-bond size from pulse tests; cell lot incoming inspection

failure_mode: Runaway spreads from one cell to neighbours
effect: Whole pack fire, no time for rider to stop
cause: Heat via ribbons and busbars (not gap filler); no coolant flowing; worst-case gas
prevention_today: Wire-bond links, slotted ribbon (<=0.03 W/K), mica on lane ends, pump kept on (screening model only)
detection_today: None physical; model: 134-249 C neighbour in no-coolant and worst cases
recommended_action: Prove with trigger test (single cell, then group of 11) with and without coolant; adopt segmented ribbon in CAD; add propagation alarm (neighbour dT/dt)

failure_mode: Vent too small, blocked or not opening at 15-20 kPa
effect: Case over-pressure, rupture, jet toward rider
cause: Undersized area (490 mm2 per group calc), ice, mud, assembly error
prevention_today: Four 600 mm2 burst vents ducted to belly (spec only, not in CAD)
recommended_action: Design plenum and vents into CAD; burst-pressure and flow test; keep path clear of rider, pump and inlet

failure_mode: Hot gas reaches rider, inlet or pump
effect: Burns, ignition of luggage, loss of coolant pump
cause: Duct ends near inlet or luggage; fall-over
prevention_today: Routing rule: belly exit away from pump, motor and inlet
recommended_action: CAD check of exit location in every tip-over pose; gas-jet test in propagation test

failure_mode: Bond lift-off or fatigue under vibration
effect: Open parallel branch, hot spot, pack current imbalance, possible loss of power
cause: Road vibration, thermal cycling, 160,000 km spectrum
prevention_today: Wire-bond design; slotted ribbon
recommended_action: Shaker test (R136 8A profile) on modules with resistance monitoring; bond pull tests in production

failure_mode: Cell moves or chafes against holder under shock
effect: Can wear-through, short, venting
cause: Holder creep, tolerance, thermal cycling
prevention_today: Not designed in detail (case 3-4 mm, holders per CAD)
recommended_action: Shock/vibration test of modules; holder material and tolerance review

item: Pack case front wall and seams
failure_mode: Seam or wall fails in a 20 g frontal crash (FEA 167 MPa vs 140 allowable at 4 mm)
effect: Pack shifts or opens, cell damage in crash
cause: Thin wall, re-entrant corners
prevention_today: FEA found it; fix is 5 mm front wall plus floor ribs (not yet in CAD)
recommended_action: Adopt 5 mm front wall and ribs; run cell-backed crash analysis; sled test of case

failure_mode: Rock strike dents case into cells
effect: Cell damage, runaway, loss of isolation
cause: Bottom-out or rock; case 3-4 mm; cells 1-2 mm from wall in rev C
prevention_today: 6 mm 5083 skid (old study); crush zone proposed
recommended_action: Cell-backed crush analysis, then rock-strike test; keep 10 mm crush zone

failure_mode: Short-circuit current (3.4-6.2 kA) not cleared safely; fuse I2t not checked
effect: Busbar or cell damage, fire
cause: No fuse curve selected
prevention_today: 400 A fuse, pyro cut-off 22 kA class
recommended_action: Select fuse from curve; bench short-circuit at pack voltage

failure_mode: BMS fails to stop over-charge, over-discharge or over-temperature
effect: Cell overcharge, plating, thermal runaway
cause: Software/hardware fault; BMS is not ISO 26262 certified
prevention_today: Redundant voltage trip in hardware; contactor open command (to be defined)
recommended_action: Hazard analysis with ASIL for pack; add independent hardware over-voltage and over-temperature cut; HIL fault injection

failure_mode: Sense wire open or high-resistance
effect: BMS blind to a group, wrong SOC, late fault
cause: Vibration, connector fretting
prevention_today: Fuses and connector boundary at MSD
recommended_action: Include sense loop in vibration test; confirm Orion open-wire detection

failure_mode: Lithium plating from charging cold cells
effect: Capacity loss, internal shorts over time
cause: Rider ignores preheat; heater marginal (25.4 min)
prevention_today: Preheat on navigate-to-charger; charge current derate by temperature
recommended_action: Verify derate map and preheat on cold chamber; plating check by cell teardown

failure_mode: Cell reaches 60.9 C (limit 60 C)
effect: Accelerated ageing, possible cell damage
cause: Heat load and ram factor 0.25 is an estimate
prevention_today: Hot-day derate to about 105 mph after about 10 min
recommended_action: Validate on climatic chassis dyno; confirm EMRAX allows >50 C inlet

failure_mode: Fast-charge cycle life lower than needed
effect: Faster fade, warranty cost
cause: Datasheet v0.1 has no 2C life curve
prevention_today: 12.5 A per cell (42% of the stated max)
recommended_action: Written cell charge-life data from Molicel; 1,000-cycle test with DC fast charge; P50B fallback (+9 kg)

failure_mode: Isolation loss (water, chafe, coolant leak)
effect: Electric shock, false trips
cause: Fording, damaged cable, connector seal
prevention_today: Isolation monitor (210 kohm fault), IPXXD boxes, HVIL
recommended_action: Isolation and ingress tests; routing rules for chafe

failure_mode: Contactor welded closed or HVIL loop open and undetected
effect: Bus stays live after stop or crash
cause: Switching under load, inrush
prevention_today: Weld check, opens only below 350 A, HVIL
recommended_action: Short-circuit and endurance of contactors at pack voltage

failure_mode: Bus takes about 88 s to fall below 60 V (inverter bleed 70 kohm)
effect: Shock risk for rescuers after crash
cause: Active discharge not yet specified with Cascadia
prevention_today: None
recommended_action: Specify active discharge (below 60 V in 3 s) with Cascadia; measure

failure_mode: Does not fire on crash or hard fault
effect: Pack stays connected into a damaged circuit
cause: Sensor or logic fault, crash flag lost
prevention_today: Dual triggers (shunt, ABS/IMU crash flag, BMS latch)
recommended_action: Fault injection and crash-pulse test of trigger chain

failure_mode: False trigger at speed
effect: Instant loss of propulsion and regen at speed
cause: Noise on shunt, IMU false crash flag
prevention_today: Thresholds 650 A/20 ms; 480 A/40 s
recommended_action: Calibrate thresholds on rig and in road tests; log events

item: Pack breathing and connectors in water
failure_mode: Hot pack drawn into cold water, water pulled past seals
effect: Isolation loss, corrosion, short
cause: Pressure drop with no vent (about 10%)
prevention_today: Membrane vent with burst function (spec); IP67 below 550 mm
recommended_action: Hot-into-cold wading and IP67 test; route vents high

failure_mode: Overtemperature at coolant 65 C (limit is an estimate)
effect: Torque derate or shutdown at speed
cause: Hot day, hot loop
prevention_today: Derate in firmware; coolant order places inverter second
recommended_action: Get Cascadia coolant derate curve; validate on dyno

failure_mode: Unintended or excessive drive torque
effect: Unwanted acceleration, loss of control
cause: Software, sensor or CAN fault
prevention_today: Dual plausibility check in VCU and inverter
detection_today: Cross-check of torque request vs feedback
recommended_action: Hazard analysis, ASIL assignment, HIL fault injection, vehicle fault tests

failure_mode: Inverter overcurrent trip at low-SOC high power
effect: Sudden torque loss on overtake
cause: 650 A vs 740 A rating, voltage sag to about 300 V
prevention_today: Current limit 350 A DC; torque derate with SOC
recommended_action: Dyno at 300-330 V and cold; confirm peak power at actual bus voltage

failure_mode: EMRAX housing cannot carry the belt-loop load (11.3 kN design pull)
effect: Housing deformation, belt tension loss, or frame needs far more mass (tail rail 1,388 MPa without the yoke)
cause: EMRAX publishes no housing limit; FEA assumed it is rigid
prevention_today: Assumption only; belt-side arm or motor-in-pivot casing considered as alternatives
recommended_action: Ask EMRAX for housing and shaft loads; static proof of the housing under belt-loop load; decide belt-side arm option now if EMRAX declines

failure_mode: Belt breaks or tooth shear
effect: Loss of drive; debris near tyre; regen lost
cause: Shock load, misalignment, stone ingress, age
prevention_today: Sized for 11.3 kN design pull; guard
recommended_action: Belt durability rig with launch and regen reversals; guard design; spares and wear interval

failure_mode: Arm flexes (lateral 1.0 kN/mm) and belt walks off or jumps teeth
effect: Belt damage, tooth jump, noise
cause: Lateral load, hub tolerance, wheel alignment
prevention_today: Flanged pulleys (to specify); tensioning procedure
recommended_action: Measure belt tracking on rig and in road tests under lean and bump; confirm flange design

failure_mode: Pulley fatigue, fretting or bolt loosening (30 m/s, 220 Nm)
effect: Drive loss, possible wheel lock if pulley seizes
cause: Cyclic torque, runout
prevention_today: Gates stock sizes for 8 mm pitch; no fatigue analysis yet
recommended_action: Rig durability including pulley-to-hub joint; retention torque check

failure_mode: Fatigue crack at brace bolt-on (damage about 4 unreinforced)
effect: Arm cracks, rear wheel alignment lost
cause: Unreinforced bolt-on, casting porosity
prevention_today: Cast boss and rib required (not designed); X-ray casting inspection
recommended_action: Design boss and rib; casting NDT plan; fatigue test of full arm to 1.5 lives

failure_mode: Overload or short life (43.6 kN in, 33.4 kN out at design; CAD span of 36 mm gives 85/74 kN)
effect: Bearing failure, pivot play, handling loss
cause: Rev C 46 mm pivot and 6008 bearings cannot carry the load
prevention_today: FEA result; fix is 62 mm stub, 80 mm span, about 50 mm tapered rollers (CAD change request, not applied)
recommended_action: Apply CAD change; bearing life calculation; pivot rig test at 1.2x design plus the 21 kN slider case

item: Pivot stub to yoke joint (belt-side move open item)
failure_mode: Joint fatigue or slip where belt loop closes through stubs and motor housing
effect: Loss of rear axle alignment; crack in stub
cause: Joint not designed; slider load 21 kN not checked
prevention_today: Open FEA item
recommended_action: Design the joint; test with V07/V08; reconsider arm on belt side if it fails

item: Cross brace and shock force path
failure_mode: Little margin: SF 1.22 on rear bump (required 1.2), falls to 1.18 at 255 kg
effect: Brace yield, rear suspension misalignment
cause: Mass growth beyond 240 kg
prevention_today: Mass target T1 enforced
recommended_action: Hold T1; reinforce at bolt-on; include in frame fatigue test

failure_mode: Weld fatigue crack (Miner D 0.40-0.49 vs 0.5)
effect: Frame crack, handling loss, possible separation
cause: 2x harsher real spectrum would fail; nominal-stress method
prevention_today: Wall sizes from sizing loop; CAD change request pending
recommended_action: Rig test to 1.5 lives with crack monitoring; measure real road loads on a mule

failure_mode: Below the 1.5 kN/mm target; weave or wobble at 77-130 mph
effect: Instability at speed, gust sensitivity
cause: Single-sided arm, thin tubes, 3 mm case option lowers it by 25%
prevention_today: Torsion 4.4 kNm/deg passes
recommended_action: Modal and wobble test; adjust steering damper and trail; keep case at 4-5 mm

failure_mode: Fade or insufficient stopping from 125-130 mph
effect: Longer stopping distance, FMVSS 122 high-speed test fail
cause: No stopping analysis from 125 mph yet
prevention_today: Fallback to dual 320 mm (+0.95 kg)
recommended_action: Brake dyno then vehicle high-speed stop; decide 300 vs 320 mm before CAD freeze

failure_mode: Regen torque locks the rear wheel or reduces total deceleration
effect: Rear wheel lock, fall
cause: Blending software not written; ABS 10 class unit
prevention_today: Regen limited to dry grip (planned)
recommended_action: Calibrate on low-mu surfaces; regen off for the friction-only FMVSS 122 tests

failure_mode: Loss of ABS function
effect: Wheel lock on slippery surface
cause: Electrical fault, sensor dirt
prevention_today: ABS warning lamp (FMVSS 123 table 3)
recommended_action: Fault injection on vehicle

item: NACS inlet and 35 mm2 cables at 137 A
failure_mode: Connector or cable overheats during 20 min DC charge
effect: Melted inlet, fire
cause: Poor contact, small cable (35 mm2 is 161 A bundled)
prevention_today: Inlet rated 500 A; temperature sensor planned
recommended_action: Thermal soak at 137 A and 40 C ambient with thermocouples; add inlet NTC to EVCC

failure_mode: AC and DC paths closed at once
effect: Station fault, shock, charger damage
cause: Relay weld, logic fault
prevention_today: Mechanical and electronic interlock (defined, not built)
recommended_action: Fault-injection test of the interlock

failure_mode: Session fails or no Supercharger authorisation
effect: Rider cannot fast charge on some stations
cause: Not on Tesla's list; ISO 15118 cert not in place
prevention_today: Test on non-Tesla stations with adapter; apply to Tesla
recommended_action: Interoperability test against at least 6 station models; do not promise Supercharger access

failure_mode: Pump failure or loss of flow
effect: Overheating; the heat-sink effect that limits propagation is lost
cause: Pump at edge of rating; air lock
prevention_today: BMS derates; pump kept on after thermal event
recommended_action: Pressure-drop measurement of EMRAX jacket and CM200DX plate; endurance run

item: Hoses, manifolds and ribbons in pack
failure_mode: Coolant leak into pack or HV box
effect: Isolation loss, short
cause: Clamp or fitting failure, ribbon pinhole
prevention_today: Pack coolant 1.1 kg; leak sensing not specified
recommended_action: Burst and leak tests on ribbons, hoses and manifolds; add pack leak sensor

failure_mode: Throttle sensor fault, stuck torque request
effect: Unintended acceleration
cause: Sensor or wiring fault
prevention_today: Dual sensors, plausibility in VCU and inverter
recommended_action: Hazard analysis; HIL and vehicle tests

failure_mode: VCU or CAN fault: torque lost or held
effect: Loss of propulsion or stuck torque at speed
cause: Software defect, bus fault
prevention_today: Two CAN buses, 120 ohm terminated
recommended_action: Safe-state design (torque to zero within the fault tolerant time); HIL

failure_mode: Lamp spacing and photometry do not comply (rev C fails; V1 design unchecked)
effect: Failed certification; poor visibility
cause: Styling light band replaces a lamp
prevention_today: Certified DOT lamp modules behind the band (planned)
recommended_action: Check CAD against 108 spacing before freeze; photometry on the real band

failure_mode: DC-DC failure; 12 V battery flat after parking
effect: Lights, ABS and VCU lost; about 28 min limp
cause: DC-DC fault, parasitic drain (9 days standby)
prevention_today: Daily wake and top-up; limp-home
recommended_action: Limp-home test and standby drain test

failure_mode: No brake lamp when regen slows the bike
effect: Rear-end collision
cause: Stop lamp wired to levers only
prevention_today: Planned: lamp on regen deceleration
recommended_action: Define threshold (e.g. above 0.1 g); verify on vehicle

item: Steel pivot yoke (rev E, cross-member Z545)
failure_mode: Weld or section fatigue/yield under belt pull or stiffness shortfall
effect: Axle misalignment, belt tension loss, frame crack
cause: Belt-loop load 11.3 kN design; FEA at 240 kg scaling
prevention_today: Steel yoke designed in rev E; FEA Round 2
recommended_action: Static and fatigue rig; re-run FEA at 257.5 kg with yoke at Z545; confirm weld class

failure_mode: Controller/valve/speed-signal fault leaves damper unscheduled
effect: Wobble unstable 15-85 mph without damper (zeta -0.15); fixed stiff setting kills weave damping at 130 mph
cause: Electronics or sensor fault
prevention_today: Speed-scheduled damper (15-dynamics.md)
recommended_action: Define fail-safe state with supplier (proposal: fixed medium damping plus speed limit near 85 mph); dash warning; fault-injection test
